title: galeopsis ladanum proles carpetana
intro: Galeopsis ladanum proles carpetana, commonly known as Spanish galega or galega, is a perennial plant that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including the relief of symptoms associated with colds, fever, and respiratory issues, as well as its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to stimulate circulation, reduce fever, and ease respiratory congestion. The bioactive constituents of Galeopsis ladanum proles carpetana include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
